title: Part-time hours and time-zone bounds

units.rationale: The role’s inclusive 24–28 hour interval exactly fits the requested interval.
required_points: Both intervals are 24–28 paid hours per week.
forbidden_inferences: Do not compare this against a full-time equivalent salary.

units.rationale: Required overlap 13:00–17:00 lies within candidate availability 12:00–17:00, including the end boundary.
required_points: The required overlap ends at 17:00 Europe/Zurich.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat 17:00 as after the candidate ceiling.

units.rationale: Proration without a base amount does not establish the candidate’s part-time pay target.
required_points: No annual base range is published.
forbidden_inferences: Do not compute pay from an absent full-time figure.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Part-time hours and time-zone bounds: the overlap preference or its cited role term.
Treating unpublished prorated annual base pay as meeting CHF 100,000 falsely resolves pref_pay.

notes: Inclusive endpoints matter; the missing base amount cannot be reconstructed from proration language.
